LOCAL SOURCE EXCERPT, read from filesystem; line numbers preserved.
85: ra11a_sql_materializer = "Blocked: @electric-sql/pglite-sync 0.6.9 with @electric-sql/pglite 0.5.8, @electric-sql/client 1.0.14, and @electric-sql/experimental 1.0.14 received HTTP 400 for unsupported log=full at the authorized FRF facade before materialization and has not proved crash-safe coordinated commits; adoption is prohibited. A future candidate must still pass the 512 MiB incremental RSS gate."
86: ra11c_pem_persistence_control = "Approved independently of materializer adoption: exact PEM core/react 4.0.3-ra11c.1.g071b9e5.sbb3dc7729aa7 add an optional scoped-runtime persistence switch used only by the memory-only browser qualification. The default remains enabled. Offline frozen install and the prior 158-test focused source passed; the current authority-freshness source passes its 11 focused tests, and ordered cold folding passes 22 transport tests plus effective delete-last and missing-update negative controls. TypeScript and lint pass. Current-source mounted update/delete/crash/refetch, restart, owner fence, checkpoint and graph parity passed all 11 behavioral checks and five cleanup checks; the mounted restart also disproved and reversed a proposed stale-plan generation guard. The aggregate suite remains Build-only because varying PGlite cases time out on this host. This pin does not approve the blocked RA11c PGlite materializer."
87: ra11c_sql_materializer = "Blocked from production adoption: the bounded internal FRF adapter preserves Electric message order during cold folding, requires update to target an existing cold row, and passes current-source mounted update/delete/crash/refetch, restart, owner-fence, checkpoint and graph-parity behavior with all 11 checks and five cleanup checks true. The live authority guard passes 11 focused tests; the transport passes 22 tests and its denial errors do not consume or publish upstream response bodies; the transport/writer/runtime/ledger set passes 75 tests with effective negative controls and preserves insert/update operation semantics; TypeScript and lint pass. The aggregate suite remains Build-only because varying PGlite cases time out on this host. PGlite 0.5.8 peaks at 1,016,692,736 incremental RSS bytes above the fixed 536,870,912-byte limit for the 16,203-row memory-only browser baseline; heap passes at 77,579,792 bytes. GraphProvider keeps the materializer disabled by default and accepts only VITE_ASO_ENABLE_RA11C_MATERIALIZER=experimental for qualification runs. This evidence does not approve @electric-sql/pglite-sync or a raised post-measurement threshold."
